sum: Edoras Investment Holdings Pte. Ltd filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE regarding a substantial acquisition of shares in Nephrocare Health Services Limited, triggering mandatory open-offer requirements under the SEBI Takeover Regulations, 2011.
detail: Edoras Investment Holdings Pte. Ltd, a Singapore-incorporated investment entity, submitted disclosure documentation to NSE on 8 May 2026 under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure typically follows either (i) acquisition crossing 25% threshold, or (ii) acquisition of control. Nephrocare Health Services Limited operates in the specialised renal care segment in India. The filing triggers mandatory open-offer obligations; the acquirer must now publish an open offer to acquire up to 26% of public shareholding at a price determined per Schedule IV methodology.
